schemeTitle: PM YASASVI (PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India)

claims.claim: Umbrella scheme for OBC, EBC, and DNT/SNT students under Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
claims.sourceTitle: Operational Guidelines for PM-YASASVI on National Scholarship Portal
claims.evidenceQuote: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India (PM-YASASVI) is an umbrella scheme for OBC, EBC and DNT students implemented by MoSJE.

claims.claim: Family income ceiling is strictly ₹2.50 Lakh per annum.
claims.evidenceQuote: The total annual family income of the parents/guardians from all sources should not exceed Rs. 2.50 lakh per annum.

claims.claim: Pre-Matric scholarship is ₹4,000/year; Top Class school is up to ₹75k (9-10) and ₹1.25L (11-12).
claims.sourcePublisher: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
claims.evidenceQuote: Pre-matric scholarship rate is Rs. 4,000 per annum. Top class school scholarship covers up to Rs. 75,000 p.a. for class 9-10 and Rs. 1,25,000 p.a. for class 11-12.

crossSchemeRelationship: Consolidates 5 sub-components: Pre-Matric, Post-Matric, Top Class School, Top Class College, and Hostels.
examTrapVerified: Confirmed: Selection for Top Class School Education uses merit lists from National Scholarship Portal (NSP).
